Source reference for P5.3 vendor-derived metadata

The large JSON fixture embedded in Tests/Phase5Milestone3Tests.cpp under
AuthenticNodeMetadataJson and AuthenticNodeModesJson is derived from metadata
published by the genshin-ts project.

Upstream project: genshin-ts
Repository: https://github.com/josStorer/genshin-ts

Pinned revision:
26bdf2a9a3fadba934423940489236f0b53eb3ea

Source resource:
resources/client_node_metadata.json
Pinned Git blob: 93237c724f6453650ae9394077620c6e0fddb3d3

Mode resource:
resources/client_node_modes.json
Pinned Git blob: b7e14a0dd7102ccd682235cf958a2d3d36378033

Miliastra++ consumer:
Tests/Phase5Milestone3Tests.cpp

Miliastra++ uses a bounded P5.3 test fixture selected from these resources.
The embedded node metadata contains the selected client boolean-filter records
required by the P5.3 contract, not the complete upstream metadata dataset. The
node metadata subset was mechanically selected from the pinned source resource,
and the mode document is based on the pinned mode resource.

Miliastra++ does not claim authorship of the upstream-derived metadata. This
directory is reserved for attribution and licensing information associated with
that material. A copy of the upstream project's license should be kept beside
this file.
